content: function HandleMessage [SWS_DM_00311] Upstream: RS_Diag_04147 , RS_Diag_04168 virtual void HandleMessage ( UdsMessagePtr message) noexcept=0; Hands over a valid received UDS message (currently this is only a request type) from the Transport Layer to the Session Layer. This corresponds to T_Data.ind of Figure 2 from ISO 14229-2 [25] . The behavior is asynchronously, i.e. the UDS Message is handed over to the Session Layer and it is expected, that it "instantly" returns, which means, that real processing of the message shall be done asynchronously by the Transport Layer!
